title: [RCCL] Add gfx1151 support and fix some build issues
author: sstamenk
body:
Motivation: Add RCCL support for the gfx1151 GPU target. The PR adds gfx1151 to the supported GPU list, architecture guards, generic tuning, and build fixes.

Test plan/result: built RCCL for gfx1151; built and ran the RCCL unit test suite on a single gfx1151 GPU; verified PyTorch loads RCCL and reports it available.

Limitations: Testing was performed on a single gfx1151 GPU only. Multi-GPU and multi-node cluster validation is still pending.
completeness: body condensed only by removal of non-substantive checklist; all test-boundary wording retained
